about: Episode 3 of EPISODES.md as a tour: the bigger model writes faster. Qwen3.8 27B against Qwen3.6 35B-A3B on the DGX Spark, the question prompt, the close-up on the memory. Every number comes from labs/data through the mission's metrics.
title: The bigger model writes {moeX:spark} faster

short.lesson: Each word reads {activeB:q36} of its {totalB:q36} parameters
short.next: Next: I gave my idle GPU 32 jobs

steps.title: 27B: every cell, every word
text: {model} is dense: all {totalB} of its parameters work on every word.
So every word reads all {perTokenGB} from memory: watch the sweep cross every cell.
steps.metaphor: Think of it as reading the whole encyclopedia for every word you write.

breakIt.label: make it 16-bit
breakIt.caption: Full size: even more to read for every word.

steps.caption: A dense model reads every cell for every word.

steps.title: 35B: only a slice
text: {model} is bigger: {totalB} parameters, more cells lit.
But it is a mixture of experts, and each word reads only {activeB} of them.
Only a handful of cells flash per word.
steps.metaphor: Think of it as a library where each question needs one aisle.

breakIt.label: back to the dense 27B
breakIt.caption: Dense again: every word reads every cell.

steps.caption: The bigger model reads only a slice for each word.

steps.title: {moeX} faster on the same machine
text: Both answer the same question on {the}.
Fewer bytes per word means more words per second.
steps.metaphor: Think of it as a lighter truck on the same road.

breakIt.label: use an RTX 5090
breakIt.caption: On a faster bus the gap shrinks: the experts' overhead shows.

steps.caption: Same Spark, same question: the bigger model wins.

steps.title: Mission Report
text: The 35B mixture of experts on five machines.
Every machine writes it faster than the dense 27B, by less on the fastest buses.
steps.metaphor: Think of it as the same light truck on five different roads.

breakIt.label: go back to the dense 27B
breakIt.caption: Dense on every machine: slower everywhere.

steps.caption: Next: I gave my idle GPU 32 jobs.
